analyzed_vuln.description: OptimizeByResampling builds a replacement CLUT using nGridPoints from _cmsReasonableGridpointsByColorspace() (or 2 for empty pipelines) and then installs interpolation params used by TetrahedralInterp16. For this PoV, the generated CLUT has too few entries (6-byte table = 3 uint16 values), but interpolation in TetrahedralInterp16 assumes neighbor offsets (X1/Y1/Z1) are valid and reads LutTable[X1]/[Y1]/[Z1], causing an out-of-bounds read. Root cause is missing validation/clamping in the optimizer path that creates/accepts an undersized CLUT/interp parameter combination for tetrahedral interpolation.
analyzed_vuln.conditions: Triggered via cms_transform_all_fuzzer during cmsCreateTransform() optimization path (_cmsOptimizePipeline -> OptimizeByResampling -> FixWhiteMisalignment -> cmsPipelineEval16 -> PrelinEval16 -> TetrahedralInterp16). A crafted profile/pipeline that leads resampling to create a tiny 3-channel CLUT (allocation seen from cmsStageAllocCLut16bitGranular, 6 bytes total) and then evaluates it with tetrahedral interpolation causes neighbor-index reads past the end of the table.
